rationale: The assistant correctly identified a door-balance spring/cable failure from the outset and, after the customer reported the twang and a loose spring on the right with no tension, confirmed a right-hand balance fault that matches the hidden truth exactly. Safety handling was good ('do not pull the spring, as it can be under tension', isolate, support the door). Weaknesses: it never asked for the full model number or whether the customer could pull the unit out, did not mention replacing springs in pairs, and escalated to an engineer without exploring the DIY route, though given the customer cannot slide the unit out this was the right practical outcome. No fabrication, no unjustified parts, no looping.
